dogecoin.text: The SEC's delay on Solana and Litecoin ETFs raises eyebrows, especially as it invites public comments on Dogecoin and BlackRock. This move highlights ongoing scrutiny in the crypto market. 💋

Grayscale's move to file for a spot Dogecoin ETF right after the SEC's delay on 21Shares shows the fierce competition in the crypto space. Will this push Dogecoin into the mainstream? Exciting times ahead! 💋
